attempts.summary: Restored secure local mail delivery for branch.test on node1. Postfix 3.8.5 is enabled; helpdesk delivers to alice and bob, accounts only to bob, unknown users and unrelated-domain relaying are rejected. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and fully recovered. RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1, SELinux enforcement, SSH access, and protected handover files were preserved.
